summary: @onereach/si-collapsible-group 0.6.4 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises a Vue collapsible-group UI component but declares a preinstall hook ("node setup.mjs") that, at install time, downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from GitHub releases and uses execFileSync to run a sibling file math_init.js under that runtime. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle obfuscated with a large mangled string array and a rotation function (WV8StW), and setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with _0x-style identifiers wrapping fs/https calls. Neither the Bun runtime nor math_init.js is required for a UI collapsible-group component. Both math_init.js and setup.mjs are shipped at the tarball root even though package.json declares files: ["lib/*"], so they fall outside the author's declared manifest. The obfuscated payload's true behavior cannot be determined before it executes on the installing host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
